title: Pisau Setengah Jari
genre: Malay spaghetti-western cinematic ballad (Morricone-style desert-circus soundtrack)
subject: a circus knife-thrower's wife who stands against the wooden board every night as his target, the knife that lands half a finger from her ear tonight, and her dry verdict that he is getting better
caption: Malay spaghetti-western cinematic ballad in a slow marching two-beat. Twangy baritone electric guitar with spring reverb carrying the melody, muted trumpet answering, tremolo strings holding the tension, timpani and snare rim clicks marking the walk, acoustic guitar strum underneath. Wide dusty room reverb, cinematic stereo space. Male baritone, low register, steady dramatic sung delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, A minor. Dry, tense, then tender mood. No synth pads, no drum machine, no autotune, no whistling, no pop-trap drift, no choir.
lyrics:
[Intro - baritone guitar, trumpet]
[Verse 1]
Khemah besar di padang, matahari rendah
Dia berdiri di papan, kasut merah, pita kuning
Aku pegang pisau pertama, tangan basah
Dia kata, "Jangan pandang aku, pandang papan"
[Pre-Chorus]
Penonton diam, dram berguling perlahan
Enam bilah, enam kali aku tarik nafas
[Chorus]
Pisau setengah jari dari telinga kau
Seluruh kampung tahan nafas
Tiga puluh tahun kau tak berganjak
Aku yang menggeletar, bukan kau
[Verse 2]
Dulu mata tertutup pun aku tepat
Sekarang cermin mata aku tertinggal di khemah
Dia tahu, dia tak cakap, dia berdiri sahaja
Aku nampak pita kuning, aku bidik situ
[Pre-Chorus]
Pisau terakhir kena kayu, dekat sangat
Sehelai rambut jatuh, penonton menjerit
[Chorus]
Pisau setengah jari dari telinga kau
Dia senyum, dia buka mata
Tiga puluh tahun kau tak berganjak
Aku yang menggeletar, bukan kau
[Bridge - strings, timpani]
Dia turun papan, cabut pisau satu-satu
"Makin baik," katanya, "esok lagi"
[Chorus]
Pisau setengah jari dari telinga kau
Esok aku pakai cermin mata
Tiga puluh tahun kau tak berganjak
Aku pun tak ke mana-mana
[Outro - guitar, trumpet]
